name: set_wifi
description: Turn the phone's Wi-Fi radio on or off.

action.description: on to enable Wi-Fi, off to disable Wi-Fi

name: set_hotspot
description: Turn the phone's mobile hotspot, also called tethering, on or off so other devices can share this phone's internet connection.

action.description: on to enable the hotspot, off to disable the hotspot

name: set_torch
description: Turn the phone's flashlight, also called the torch or the light, on or off.

action.description: on to switch the flashlight on, off to switch the flashlight off

name: send_sms
description: Open a text message to a person or a phone number with the message body already filled in, ready for the user to send.

recipient.description: the person's name or the phone number the message is for

message.description: the message body, copied word for word from the request

name: set_reminder
description: Set a reminder that alerts the user at a time the user names.

when.description: the time phrase exactly as the user said it, for example 'at 5 PM' or 'tomorrow at 8:30'

text.description: what the reminder is about, copied word for word from the request
